solution:
**Explanation:**

**Logic : Number of sides of outer figure × Number of sides of inner figure × Number inside the figure = Number outside the figure**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9516aa111052ea4b3848f95055524d4c206794d0b00f3a29f56093dde452c9e.png]
